text: {"claims":[{"cid":"c1","text":"Large trials including VITAL, ViDA and D2d, with over 30,000 participants, found no prevention of cancer, cardiovascular events, falls or type 2 diabetes in vitamin D replete adults.","cited_pids":["fbce4d7a6120#1"]},{"cid":"c2","text":"Systematic reviews of fracture prevention found little to no effect from vitamin D supplements alone.","cited_pids":["53bc338e3607#3"]},{"cid":"c3","text":"A US task force recommends against vitamin D and calcium supplementation for fracture prevention in healthy postmenopausal women.","cited_pids":["9c98e4515e3d#0"]},{"cid":"c4","text":"Some guidelines still recommend vitamin D supplementation for falls or fractures despite the systematic review evidence.","cited_pids":["9c98e4515e3d#0"]},{"cid":"c5","text":"Post hoc analyses suggest modest benefits of vitamin D supplementation for vitamin D deficient individuals.","cited_pids":["fbce4d7a6120#3"]},{"cid":"c6","text":"Correcting severe vitamin D deficiency is considered essential.","cited_pids":["fbce4d7a6120#4"]},{"cid":"c7","text":"Supplementation is recommended for at-risk groups such as older adults.","cited_pids":["7aabe982f481#1"]},{"cid":"c8","text":"Supplementation is recommended for people with limited sun exposure.","cited_pids":["691df7883190#4"]},{"cid":"c9","text":"Routine daily vitamin D supplementation is not beneficial for most adults who are already vitamin D replete.","cited_pids":[]}]}
